The device is capable of producing 2D and 3D models with material building printing technology on a heated printing platform. The materials used are: compatibility composites ABS, carbon fiber and fiberglass, composite nylon carbon fiber and fiber glass, PEKK carbon fiber, PET fiberglass, PP fiberglass, PPS carbon fiber and other standard materials such as wood fiber. The maintenance must be done in Finland.
